title: #407 Health Maintenance
prompt: What is your opinion on the role of diet in maintaining good health?

promptSegments.text: What is your opinion on the role of diet in maintaining good health?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Diet is important because it provides energy and necessary nutrients.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Diet is important because it provides energy and necessary nutrients.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Diet is important because it helps the digestive system work well.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Diet is important because it helps the digestive system work well.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Diet is not the only factor for good health.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Diet is not the only factor for good health.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Rest and exercise are more important than diet.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Rest and exercise are more important than diet.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: A balanced diet provides the necessary nutrients for the body to function well.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A balanced diet provides the necessary nutrients for the body to function well.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Diet also helps to prevent many serious long-term health problems.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Diet also helps to prevent many serious long-term health problems.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Good health requires more than just diet; lifestyle choices, such as getting enough sleep, are equally crucial for the body to repair itself.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Good health requires more than just diet; lifestyle choices, such as getting enough sleep, are equally crucial for the body to repair itself.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Physical activity is vital for maintaining good health, as exercise strengthens the body, manages weight, and improves overall energy and heart health.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Physical activity is vital for maintaining good health, as exercise strengthens the body, manages weight, and improves overall energy and heart health.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
